question: The Eleventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution relates to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Powers and responsibilities of Panchayats**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Eleventh Schedule** of the Indian Constitution was added by the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992**.
 
• This schedule contains **29 subjects** related to the functions and responsibilities of **Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs).**
